title: Machine Learning for Climate Adaptation (example)
description: Supports projects applying machine learning to climate adaptation, such as flood forecasting, drought monitoring and resilient infrastructure planning.
eligibility: Researchers holding a PhD and employed at a university or research institute in the Nordic countries.

title: Open Radio Hardware for Rural Connectivity (example)
description: Funds the development of open-source radio hardware and firmware that improves connectivity in rural and sparsely populated areas.
eligibility: Small companies and sole proprietors registered in Sweden.

title: Early-Career Grant in Molecular Biology (example)
description: Supports independent research in molecular and cell biology by researchers within eight years of their PhD.
eligibility: PhD awarded within the last eight years; host institution in the EU.
